SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, STATUS FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'DHJB') ORDER BY BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, STATUS
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.BUYER, A.PO_NO AS KEP_PO_NO, A.PO_SEQ AS KEP_PO_SEQ, A.STATUS, A.KEY_10 AS COMPANY, SUBSTR(A.ADD_USER_DEPT,1,2) AS PLANT, A.LEGACY_PO_NO, A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION, A.UNIT_PRICE, A.ITEM_QTY, A.ITEM_AMT, A.ADD_DATE, A.RD_DATE, A.REMARK, A.DELY_TO_LOCATION, A.KEY_5 AS WONGA, A.LEGACY_USER_ID AS ADD_USER_ID, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.ADD_USER_ID ) AS ADD_USER_NAME, A.ADD_USER_DEPT AS ADD_USER_DEPT_CODE FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND A.PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND A.STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$' AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND A.PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND A.STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$' AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND A.PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND A.STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$' AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N'
